source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Stimulating beta receptors within the airway smooth muscle as its primary mechanism of action","B":"Producing fairly little measurable bronchodilator effect despite being prescribed specifically for that purpose","C":"Causing bronchoconstriction, an effect essentially opposite to what this medication is actually intended to produce","D":"Blocking parasympathetic (cholinergic) receptors in the airways, causing bronchodilation"}}
source_row.rationale: Ipratropium works by blocking parasympathetic (cholinergic) receptors in the airways, causing bronchodilation, a mechanism distinct from beta-agonist bronchodilators, commonly used in COPD management, often in combination with beta-agonists.
